capabilities: Transform :::type[Title] Markdown blocks into styled boxes
Support 14 box types including note, tip, info, warning, danger and highlight
Render boxes automatically in the note preview
extras: README notes that Markdown syntax inside boxes (headings, backticks) is not rendered, only plain text; instructions are given in both French and English.
problem: Obsidian's built-in callouts use a fixed syntax, and this plugin offers an alternative ::: block syntax with additional box types for highlighting sections.
summary: Block-styling plugin that renders custom :::type[Title] Markdown blocks as colored note, tip, warning and similar boxes.
